items.title: Nepali youth press COP31 presidency for grants to rebuild after disasters
items.blurb: Activists tell Australian negotiators in Antalya that countries that did little to cause the climate crisis should not have to borrow to recover from it.

items.title: Police seize Rs16.7 million in unaccounted cash in Lalitpur
items.blurb: A team from the Kathmandu Valley Crime Investigation Office recovered the money after receiving information about a suspicious financial transaction.

items.title: Nepal gets India’s approval to import 350MW and export 56MW
items.blurb: The approval allows the NEA to purchase electricity for up to 17 hours a day to meet winter demand while continuing exports from three hydropower projects.

items.title: Flood-hit Rani Mahal still awaits cleanup two months on
items.blurb: Sand, gravel and debris remain scattered across the historic palace grounds, while riverbank erosion threatens its foundations and local businesses struggle with a decline in visitors.

items.title: Nepal considers stricter IPO rules for hydropower projects
items.blurb: A draft amendment would require projects to complete at least 50 percent of construction before issuing shares, drawing mixed reactions from investors and developers.

items.title: Opposition urges PM to forge national consensus before India visit
items.blurb: Leaders say Prime Minister Shah should prioritise restoring trust and resolving longstanding disputes over border, treaties, trade, hydropower, and air routes.
